propositions: On post-rebase Verified -1, the bot must trigger a bounded single auto-recheck by posting the comment 'recheck' before recording ci_failed and handing the stack back.

The bot must enter a rechecking in-flight sub-state on the wipChain and correctly interpret the vote sequence: transient Verified→0 during recheck-run must not trigger re-post, and terminal Verified +1 must proceed to submit while Verified -1 must record ci_failed.
On rebase-conflict (POST /rebase 409), the bot must record a needs_rebase outcome and remove Autosubmit from all changes in the affected stack without attempting allow_conflicts.

Persisted state must store only needs_rebase markers keyed by change_id + patchset_SHA, self-invalidating when patchset SHA no longer matches; merged, ci_failed, and review_failed outcomes must be derived live from Gerrit, never persisted.

On failure, the entire stack must atomically return to its owning agent (stack uploader); no partial-land or change eviction is permitted, and Autosubmit must be removed from every change in the stack.

Marker acknowledgment must be idempotent: recorded as acknowledged=false, set to true after Autosubmit removal completes, and on restart any acknowledged=false marker must re-drive removal to completion.
